## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* late-Táng record of Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* ([KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157), T1927), extracted-and-published (錄出 *lùchū*) by **Dàosuì** 道邃 — the tenth Tiāntái patriarch and Saichō's Chinese teacher. The work preserves the *Shí bùèr mén* in a slightly different recension or with editorial framing distinct from the Taishō T1927 recension, demonstrating the post-Zhànrán textual transmission at Tiāntáishān.

**Abstract**

Dàosuì's *Shí bùèr mén yì* belongs together with his *Zhǐguān jìzhōng yìyì* ([KR6d0136](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0136)) as the principal documentary witnesses to Dàosuì's role as the post-Zhànrán Tiāntái scholastic transmitter at Tiāntáishān. The work is consequently of substantial historiographical importance for the modern reconstruction of late-Táng Tiāntái scholastic activity.

The composition is bracketed within Dàosuì's productive period c. 800–850.
